newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-UNIBANKA FALLS AHEAD OF AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-UNIBANKA FALLS AHEAD OF AUCTION.

text.p: Latvia's market remained focused on Unibanka on Friday ahead of Monday's auction of one million of the state's shares in the bank, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 73,000 lats and the Rietumu index eased 0.51 percent to 149.65.
Unibanka accounted for close to half of the sluggish market's volume in trade of 33,300 lats.
Dealers anticpate that it will fall further on Monday, when one million of the government's shares are auctioned off for a minimum price of 3.05 lats.
"Unibanka is really worth at least 3.40 lats to 3.50 lats...it will climb after the auction," said one broker.
Three of the other five official list shares held steady while two gained slightly.
The Riga Transport Fleet, which inched up to 1.25 lats from 1.24 lats, released its first half results after the price fix. They showed a net profit of 1.8 million lats.
"The market was expecting a result in this range...I don't think it will move its price much," said one dealer.
On the secondary list, good interim results did produce some significant price movements.
Jekabpils Sugar rose to 70 santimes from 66 santimes after adding almost 14 percent on Thursday. Its six-month profit of over 500,000 lats was way beyond anything expected by the market.
Olainfarm, a pharmaceutical producer, leapt to 2.35 lats from 2.13 lats on the strength of its solid first quarter results. Its financial year begins on April 1.
